description: This file defines the EmployeeLicenseDao class, which handles data access operations related to employee licenses in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching employee license records, as well as fetching allowed licenses, indicating its role in managing employee licensing data.

classes.name: EmployeeLicenseDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for performing database operations related to EmployeeLicense entities in the HR system.

methods.name: saveEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Persists an EmployeeLicense entity to the database.

methods.name: getEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Retrieves a specific EmployeeLicense by employee number and license ID.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeLicenses
methods.description: Deletes multiple EmployeeLicense records for a given employee.

methods.name: searchEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Searches for employee licenses based on provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeLicensesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employee licenses matching the search criteria.

methods.name: getEmployeeAllowedLicenses
methods.description: Fetches licenses that are allowed for a specific employee, optionally filtered.

methods.name: getEmployeeAllowedLicensesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of allowed licenses for a specific employee based on filter parameters.
